pages.text: The bakery oven is first lit at dawn. Coco is always asleep and has never seen it.
"Tomorrow I want to watch too." Mom nodded. "I'll wake you at dawn."
Grandpa Mole heard as he passed. "At dawn? I'll wake you."
Coco went to bed early. Their heart fluttered as they closed their eyes.
Bang, bang, bang! Knocking at the door woke everyone.
"It's dawn! Time to light the fire!" Grandpa called brightly.
The sky was still black and full of stars. It was the middle of the night.
"It's always dark in a mole's burrow, you see..." Grandpa scratched his head.
They all slept a little longer. This time Mom woke Coco gently.
Whoosh! The first fire blazed in the oven. Coco's eyes sparkled. Beside Coco, Grandpa gave the loudest "Oooh!"
